package rpcheaders_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	svc "example.com/rpcheaders/gen/headers"
	client "example.com/rpcheaders/gen/jsonrpc/headers/client"
	server "example.com/rpcheaders/gen/jsonrpc/headers/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
)

func TestResponseCollectionsRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	for _, value := range []*svc.MetadataResult{
		{Tags: []string{"a", "b"}, Numbers: []int{1, 2}},
		{Tags: []string{}, Numbers: []int{}},
	} {
		mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
		endpoints := &svc.Endpoints{Metadata: func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
			return value, nil
		}}
		server.Mount(mux, server.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil))
		host := httptest.NewServer(mux)
		t.Cleanup(host.Close)
		u, err := url.Parse(host.URL)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		c := client.NewClient(u.Scheme, u.Host, host.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
		res, err := c.Metadata()(context.Background(), &svc.MetadataPayload{ID: "request"})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, value, res)
	}
}

func TestResponseCollectionsIndependentPeer(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name    string
		tags    []string
		numbers []int
		want    *svc.MetadataResult
	}{
		{"body-collections", []string{"a", "b, c"}, []int{1, 2, 3}, &svc.MetadataResult{Tags: []string{"a", "b, c"}, Numbers: []int{1, 2, 3}}},
		{"absent-defaults", nil, nil, &svc.MetadataResult{Tags: []string{"fallback"}, Numbers: []int{7}}},
		{"present-empty", []string{}, []int{}, &svc.MetadataResult{Tags: []string{}, Numbers: []int{}}},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			body := make(map[string]any)
			if tc.tags != nil {
				body["tags"] = tc.tags
			}
			if tc.numbers != nil {
				body["numbers"] = tc.numbers
			}
			encoded, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": "request", "result": body})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			response := &http.Response{
				StatusCode: http.StatusOK,
				Header:     make(http.Header),
				Body:       io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(string(encoded))),
			}
			res, err := client.DecodeMetadataResponse(loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)(response)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, tc.want, res)
		})
	}
}

// TestBatchResponseCollections preserves per-envelope values and physical middleware metadata.
func TestBatchResponseCollections(t *testing.T) {
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	calls := 0
	endpoints := &svc.Endpoints{Metadata: func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
		calls++
		return &svc.MetadataResult{Tags: []string{"a,b", ""}, Numbers: []int{calls}}, nil
	}}
	server.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil).Mount(mux)
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/rpc", strings.NewReader(`[{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"one","method":"metadata"},{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"two","method":"metadata"}]`))
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	response.Header().Set("X-Middleware", "retained")
	http.SetCookie(response, &http.Cookie{Name: "middleware", Value: "retained"})
	mux.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	require.Equal(t, 2, calls)
	require.Equal(t, "retained", response.Header().Get("X-Middleware"))
	require.Contains(t, response.Header().Get("Set-Cookie"), "middleware=retained")
	var envelopes []struct {
		ID     string             `json:"id"`
		Result svc.MetadataResult `json:"result"`
	}
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &envelopes))
	require.Len(t, envelopes, 2)
	for i, id := range []string{"one", "two"} {
		require.Equal(t, id, envelopes[i].ID)
		require.Equal(t, []string{"a,b", ""}, envelopes[i].Result.Tags)
		require.Equal(t, []int{i + 1}, envelopes[i].Result.Numbers)
	}
}
